name: Vanity auras stay applied when their visuals are refreshed after a transform (#9463)
contract: Blazing Irie Wings 12000142 is a vanity aura (skill line 120) whose wings are a client-side spell visual. When a
transform ends the client rebuilds the player model without that visual, so 300 ms after the player is back on
the native display the server re-sends each vanity aura to the client as removed and then added. The removal is
client-only. Expected: after Herald of the Depths 520326 is cancelled and the refresh has fired, the Cultist is
back on the native display and still has 12000142 applied, and the worldserver keeps running. The client
redrawing the wings is not observable here.

steps.label: SETUP: the vanity aura is applied
The Cultist is back on the native display
The vanity aura is still applied after the visual refresh
